Curriculum

6 Courses. 16 Modules.
One Complete Program.

From foundations to freelancing — every module is built with AI at its core and real-world application in mind.

148+ Total Lectures
  • What is Digital Marketing & how it evolved from traditional marketing
  • Digital Marketing vs Traditional Marketing - key differences & why it matters now
  • The Digital Marketing Ecosystem - channels, platforms & growth levers
  • Business Models - D2C, B2B, Local Business, EdTech, SaaS (how marketing changes per model)
  • Brand Marketing vs Performance Marketing vs Growth Marketing
  • Customer Journey & Funnel Frameworks - TOFU, MOFU, BOFU with real Zomato/ Swiggy examples
  • Consumer Behavior & Buying Triggers - what makes people click, trust & buy
Tools you will master
Google TrendsClaude / Gemini / ChatGPTSimilarWebMeta Ad LibraryGoogle SheetsHubSpot Persona
Module 1 Project

Build a complete digital strategy deck for a real Indian brand - ICP, funnel map and KPI targets.

  • Brand Personality & Identity - tone, voice, visual style, how it translates online
  • Brand Positioning Strategy - owning a clear space in the customer's mind
  • Digital Visibility Fundamentals - how people discover brands (search, social, maps, directories)
  • Basics of UI & UX Design - what makes a website feel trustworthy and easy to use
  • Landing Page & Conversion Psychology - colour, copy, CTA placement & social proof
  • WordPress & Website Fundamentals - pages, themes, plugins, hosting basics
  • AI-Assisted Website Creation - building a professional site without coding
Tools you will master
Canva AIClaude / Gemini / ChatGPTGoogle TrendsHotjarWordPressFramer
Module 2 Project

Set up a full digital presence: brand identity, Google Business Profile, WhatsApp Business and social bios.

  • Website Fundamentals - what makes a website work for business vs just exist
  • Business Websites vs Marketing Websites - strategic difference & when to use which
  • Types of Websites - portfolio, business, e- commerce, blog, landing page, membership
  • Domain Names - types, extensions, choosing the right one for branding & SEO
  • Web Hosting & cPanel - shared, cloud & managed hosting, cPanel navigation & FTP
  • WordPress Introduction - why WordPress powers 43% of the internet
  • CMS Comparison - WordPress vs Wix vs Squarespace vs Webflow vs Shopify
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTGoDaddyNamecheapcPanelFileZillaWordPress
Module 3 Project

Design and launch a live WordPress + Elementor site with a lead form wired to a CRM.

  • Social Media Ecosystem - types of platforms, algorithms & what each platform rewards
  • Social Media Account Setup & Bio Optimization - first impression across every platform
  • Content Marketing Fundamentals & Growth Models - how content drives awareness & conversions
  • Content Types & Formats - short-form, long- form, static, video, carousels, stories, UGC
  • Content Pillars & Brand Voice - building a consistent identity across all platforms
  • Content Funnels - mapping content to TOFU, MOFU, BOFU stages
  • Content Calendar Creation & Multi-Platform Distribution Strategy
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTInstagramLinkedInMeta Business SuiteCanva AIGoogle Sheets
Module 4 Project

Produce a 30-day content calendar with scripted reels, carousels and captions for one brand.

  • Influencer & Creator Marketing Ecosystem - how the industry works & why it's fastest-growing
  • Types of Influencers - Nano, Micro, Macro, Mega & Celebrity - when to use each
  • Brand-Creator Fit - matching influencer audience, tone & values to brand positioning
  • Influencer Funnels & Content Formats - awareness vs conversion campaigns
  • Content Strategy for Influencer Campaigns - 3 pillars: audience, platform & content type
  • Content Buckets, Calendars & Brand Guidelines for Creator Briefs
  • How to Find Influencers - manual methods, AI- assisted discovery & platform tools
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTInstagramCanvaNotionHeepsyGmail
Module 5 Project

Build a creator campaign: shortlist, outreach brief, ASCI-compliant contract and ROI sheet.

  • Meta Advertising Ecosystem - how Facebook & Instagram ads work, auction system & algorithm
  • Facebook Business Manager & Ads Manager Setup - account, payment, billing & verification
  • Campaign Structure - Campaign > Ad Set > Ad level with real Indian brand examples
  • Campaign Objectives - Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads, Sales - when to use each
  • Budget Setting - Daily vs Lifetime budgets, CBO & Advantage+ Budget
  • Bidding Strategies - Lowest Cost, Cost Cap, Bid Cap & when to use each for better ROI
  • Ad Placements - Feed, Stories, Reels, In-Stream, Audience Network - automatic vs manual
Tools you will master
Meta Ads ManagerMeta Business ManagerClaude / Gemini / ChatGPTCanva AICapCutAdCreative.ai
Module 6 Project

Launch a live Meta campaign with real budget - Pixel, CAPI, audiences and creative tests.

  • Google Ads Ecosystem - how Google Ads works, auction system, Ad Rank & Quality Score
  • Google Ads Account Setup - billing, preferences, account structure & interface navigation
  • Campaign Types Overview - Search, Display, Shopping, Video, Discovery, App, PMax
  • Keyword Research - Google Keyword Planner, building keyword lists & competitor ad analysis
  • Keyword Match Types - Broad, Phrase, Exact & their impact on reach vs relevance
  • Negative Keywords Strategy - protecting budget from irrelevant traffic
  • Keyword Profitability Calculation - prioritizing high- ROI keywords before spending a rupee
Tools you will master
Google AdsGoogle Keyword PlannerClaude / Gemini / ChatGPTGoogle SheetsGA4Canva
Module 7 Project

Run a live Google Ads account across Search and PMax with conversion tracking in place.

  • What is SEO & How Search Engines Work - crawling, indexing & ranking explained simply
  • White Hat vs Black Hat vs Grey Hat SEO - what's safe, risky & what gets penalized
  • Keyword Research Fundamentals - types of keywords, search intent, LSI & long-tail strategy
  • Keyword Research Process - tools, volume & competition analysis, reverse competitor research
  • Future of SEO - AI Overviews, SGE, Zero-Click Strategy & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
  • On-Page SEO Fundamentals - title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URL structure
  • On-Page SEO Optimization in Practice - optimize a real page live in class
Tools you will master
Google Search ConsoleClaude / Gemini / ChatGPTSEMrushAhrefsGoogle Keyword PlannerPerplexity
Module 8 Project

Complete a full technical + on-page SEO audit and rank a live page for a target keyword.

  • Email Marketing Fundamentals - why email delivers the highest ROI of any digital channel
  • Email Ecosystem Setup - domain authentication, SPF, DKIM & DMARC records configuration
  • Choosing the Right ESP - Mailchimp, Brevo, Klaviyo & Indian alternatives
  • List Building Strategies - lead magnets, opt-in forms, landing pages & list hygiene
  • Email List Segmentation - by behaviour, demographics, purchase history & engagement
  • Email Copywriting - subject lines, preview text, body copy, CTA & mobile-first formatting
  • Email Design Fundamentals - templates, visual hierarchy, image-to-text ratio & accessibility
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTBrevoMXToolboxMailchimpKlaviyoCanva
Module 9 Project

Build an automated welcome, cart-recovery and retention flow across email and WhatsApp.

  • E-Commerce Ecosystem - Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Quick Commerce & D2C - strategic differences
  • D2C Brand Growth Strategy - how Indian D2C brands allocate budget at different growth stages
  • Shopify / D2C Store Setup - product pages, collections, payment gateway, shipping & CRO
  • Product Detail Page (PDP) Optimisation - titles, bullets, descriptions, A+ content & reviews
  • Amazon Ads Ecosystem - Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display & Video
  • Amazon Campaign Structure - auto vs manual campaigns, ad group logic & keyword harvesting
  • Amazon Keyword Research - search term discovery, match types, reverse ASIN & competitor gaps
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTShopifyRazorpayAmazon Seller CentralAmazon Ads ConsoleHelium 10
Module 10 Project

Launch and optimise a product across Amazon, Flipkart and a Shopify D2C store.

  • Marketing Automation Fundamentals - what to automate, what not to, and why timing matters
  • Sales Funnels & Lead Quality - lead stages, scoring models & what makes a lead sales-ready
  • CRM Fundamentals - what a CRM is, how it connects marketing & sales, how to choose one
  • CRM Setup & Integration - connecting CRM to website forms, ad platforms, email & WhatsApp
  • Lead Scoring & Qualification - building automated scoring systems based on behaviour & profile
  • Trigger-Based Journey Mapping - designing customer journeys that respond to real actions
  • Workflow Mapping - visualising multi-step automation flows before building them
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTZoho CRMMake.comMiron8nMailchimp
Module 11 Project

Build an end-to-end automation: lead capture, scoring, CRM sync and an AI agent follow-up.

  • Conversion Tracking Fundamentals - what a conversion is, why tracking accuracy defines success
  • Types of Conversion Actions - purchases, leads, calls, form fills, app installs & micro-conversions
  • Creating & Configuring Conversion Actions in Google Ads - setup, category, value & counting
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM) Fundamentals - tags, triggers, variables & container structure
  • GTM Setup & Installation - connecting GTM to WordPress & Shopify
  • Deploying Tracking Tags via GTM - Google Ads, Meta Pixel, GA4 without touching code
  • GA4 & Google Ads Linking - connecting both platforms for unified conversion data
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTGoogle AdsGTMWordPressMeta Pixel HelperGA4
Module 12 Project

Deploy GTM with Pixel, CAPI, GA4 events, UTMs and a working remarketing audience.

  • Digital Media Metrics - the math every marketer must know (CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, CPA, LTV, CAC)
  • ROI, Conversion Rate & Campaign Performance Calculations - Workshop
  • GA4 Setup - connecting website, property configuration & Search Console integration
  • GA4 Dashboard Navigation - understanding key reports, metrics & dimensions
  • Event Tracking & UTM Parameter Setup - tracking every click, scroll & form fill
  • User Journey Tracking - how users move from discovery to conversion
  • Traffic Source Analysis & Campaign Attribution Models
Tools you will master
Google SheetsClaude / Gemini / ChatGPTGA4GTMUTM BuilderHotjar
Module 13 Project

Build a GA4 + Looker Studio report answering five real business questions.

  • CRO Fundamentals - what CRO is, why it's the highest-ROI activity & how it compounds
  • The CRO Mindset - thinking in experiments, not opinions - data replaces guesswork
  • Setting Goals, Benchmarks & KPIs - defining what a 'conversion' means for different businesses
  • Conversion Metrics - conversion rate, bounce rate, exit rate, scroll depth & micro-conversions
  • AIDA Framework for CRO - mapping Attention, Interest, Desire & Action to page elements
  • CRO Frameworks - PIE (Potential, Importance, Ease), ICE scoring & prioritisation
  • User Journey Mapping & Funnel Analysis - identifying every drop-off point
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTGA4Google SheetsHotjarMicrosoft ClarityPageSpeed Insights
Module 14 Project

Run a full CRO teardown with heatmaps and ship an A/B test on a live page.

  • Why Reporting Matters - data storytelling builds client trust, justifies budgets & drives decisions
  • Google Sheets 101 - interface, navigation, data entry, formatting & spreadsheet best practices
  • Essential Formulas & Functions - SUM, IF, VLOOKUP, QUERY, SPARKLINE for marketing data
  • Conditional Formatting - colour-coding data to make performance patterns instantly visible
  • Data Validation & Dropdowns - building clean, error-proof input systems for campaign tracking
  • Campaign Tracking Sheet - master sheet pulling Meta, Google, SEO & email performance together
  • Budget vs Actual Tracking - monitoring spend pacing, channel allocation & ROI in real time
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTGoogle SheetsLooker StudioCanva
Module 15 Project

Build a live CEO dashboard tracking spend, leads, CAC and revenue against target.

  • Professional Identity - defining your positioning as a DM (generalist vs specialist vs T-shaped)
  • Personal Branding for Job Seekers & Freelancers - LinkedIn optimisation & online presence audit
  • Communication Fundamentals - clarity, confidence, tone & saying more with fewer words
  • Storytelling for Career Growth - how to narrate your journey, projects & results
  • Proactiveness & Ownership Mindset - what employers & clients actually look for beyond skills
  • CV Building Fundamentals - structure, sections, formatting & what recruiters scan for in 6 seconds
  • AI-Powered CV Writing - using AI to optimise wording, sharpen bullet points & match job descriptions
Tools you will master
Claude / Gemini / ChatGPTLinkedInCanvaJobscanNotionFramer
Module 16 Project

Ship an ATS-ready CV, LinkedIn profile, portfolio site and complete a mock interview.
